eval_probe.alpha_rule: 5-fold CV inside test, folds grouped by frame hash (identical clips together), seed 0, 13 log-spaced values

protocol: paper protocol (C.12): the evaluation probe is fit on the same test clips it steers; strict_eval (if run) is the extra split-half version
arm: paper: unit target (sin θ*, cos θ*) / true value required of every probe

random_nulls.rank_rule: empirical_p_to_target = (1 + #{null draws with MAE-to-target <= learned}) / (n_draws + 1); resolution 1/(n_draws + 1), small = learned beats the null
empirical_p_to_target = (1 + #{null draws with MAE-to-target <= learned}) / (n_draws + 1); resolution 1/(n_draws + 1), small = learned beats the null

radius_matched.target_rule: extra arm: probe k's target is its mean readout over train clips whose label equals the target value (its own shrinkage included); the paper's arm asks every probe for the unit/true value

off_target_probe.fit: train clips of this dataset with motion == velocity

basis: Adam C.11 probe sequence (batch 64), not the stored ridge sequence

recipe.source: App. C.11: Adam, lr 1e-3, weight decay 1e-4, 100 epochs (direction) / 50 (speed, IntPhys), MSE loss, 80/20 split; batch size not given
recipe.targets: standardised on train rows for training (mean, SD per column); probe and scores in physical units

basis_provenance.stop_rule: C.11 as stored: K = first round with test R2 < 0.1 or test MAE > 80 deg, minus one (K_first); the sequence ran on to patience 3 as stored

rank_matched_null.rank_rule: rank_matched: rank m*n (= rank of the learned basis at n); random_basis_full_rank: rank K*m at every n (the existing random_nulls.random_basis); draw j nests R_j[:, :m*n]
rank_matched_null.p_rule: empirical_p_to_target = (1 + #{null draws with MAE-to-target <= learned}) / (n_draws + 1); resolution 1/(n_draws + 1), small = learned beats the null

comparison_vs_ridge_basis.rule: single target 90 deg, paper arm; beats a null = empirical p at the 1/21 floor
comparison_vs_ridge_basis.null_dimension_note: the Adam-basis rank-2K null (random_nulls.random_basis) is 168-dimensional (2 x 84), so its draws differ from the ridge file's 74-dimensional null (2 x 37); the rank-matched nulls also draw R_j from [d, 2K] Gaussians, so their R_j[:, :2N] differ between the files too (note added after the run; numbers unchanged)

seeds.other: all other RNG seeds are 0 (bootstrap, folds, null draws, shuffles); random-removal controls use seeds 0..n-1
